research.angle: While empathy is linked to leadership effectiveness and can be improved through interventions, there is no evidence that corporate hierarchy physically reshapes neural pathways.
research.verdict: The sources show that empathy is a valuable leadership trait and can be influenced by interventions, but they do not provide any data on neural pathway changes.
research.caveat: None of the provided sources contain neurological data or studies on brain structure.
